svg.text: Lofted from the 156 x 150 fuselage face to a 60 round motor face, 55 long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print nose down with the motor face on the bed; no supports needed.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four M3 heat-set inserts in the motor face on the bolt circle of the motor bought.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four M4 bolts and epoxy hold it to the firewall; the thrust line is the fuselage centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Leave a 15 mm hole through the motor face for cooling air and the motor wires.
